text: $RenameFeynCalcObjects specifies a list of replacement rules that allow to rename FeynCalc objects on the fly to avoid conflicts with other package before FeynCalc is loaded (monkey patching). The value of $RenameFeynCalcObjects must be specified before loading FeynCalc.
